question: Which of the following is the largest artificial lake of Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhopal Lake**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhopal, known as the **"City of Lakes,**" boasts two prominent water bodies: the** Upper Lake (Bhojtal) and the Lower Lake (Chhota Talab).**
 
• **The Upper Lake**, built in the 11th century by King Bhoj, is a significant source of drinking water for the city. It's also a popular recreational spot, offering boating and scenic views.
 
• **The Lower Lake**, though smaller, contributes to the city's beauty. However, it faces pollution challenges due to urban and industrial activities.
 
• Together, these lakes form the Bhoj Wetland, a Ramsar site recognized for its ecological importance. Efforts are underway to preserve and restore the Lower Lake's ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Naini Lake**

 
 
• Uttarakhand CM Trivendra Singh Rawat__ has inaugurated the Naini lake water quality assessment system.
 
• It has been built at a cost of Rs 1 crore with UNDP assistance. 
 
• The water quality system will aid in water conservation and in keeping it clean.
 
• The State has successfully initiated a public movement to revive its rivers, lakes, ponds and water sources.
 
 
 
• Dal lake 
 
 
• It is an urban lake, which is the second largest in the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It is integral to tourism and recreation in Kashmir and is named the "Lake of Flowers", "Jewel in the crown of Kashmir" or "Srinagar's Jewel".
 
 
 
• **Chilika Lake **
 
 
• Chilika Lake is a brackish water lagoon located in the state of Odisha, India.
 
• It is the largest coastal lagoon in India and the second largest lagoon in the world.
 
• Chilika Lake is an important habitat for a variety of wildlife, including many species of birds, fish, and other aquatic animals.
 
• The lake is also a major tourist attraction and supports the livelihoods of local fishermen.
